criteria.text: `vercel.json` remains valid JSON and has no top-level `routes` key.

`vercel.json` has a top-level `rewrites` array with exactly two entries: `/api/(.*)` → `/api/index` and `/` → `/design-5.html` (same `src`/`dest` pairs as the old `routes`, renamed to `source`/`destination`). No explicit `filesystem` handle entry exists (Vercel's implicit fallback under `rewrites` is what serves `public/` statics — this is a manual pre-merge check via a Vercel preview deploy, not something `node --test` can prove, per the issue's own sequencing).
`vercel.json`'s `$schema`, `framework`, `buildCommand` and `outputDirectory` keys are present and hold the same values as before this change.

`vercel.json` has a top-level `headers` array containing at least one entry each whose `source` exactly matches `/`, `/design-5.html` and `/como-ler.html` — three distinct matched paths, verifiable by resolving every entry's `source` field programmatically.

For each of those three matched paths, the resolved header set includes a `Content-Security-Policy` value whose `script-src` directive is exactly `'self'` (no `unsafe-inline`, no `unsafe-eval`, no external host).
For each of those three matched paths, the CSP's `style-src` directive includes `'self'` and `'unsafe-inline'` (required for the `--size`/`--tone` inline overrides `render.ts` writes).

For each of those three matched paths, the resolved header set includes `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, and a `Permissions-Policy` value that denies `camera`, `microphone` and `geolocation` (each appears with an empty allowlist, e.g. `camera=()`).

`VERCEL_INSIGHTS` (`test/pages.ts`) is a same-origin path (starts with `/`, no scheme/host), so it is covered by `script-src 'self'` with no additional `connect-src`/`script-src` exception needed — checked by asserting the constant is host-relative, not by re-deriving CSP semantics.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` both pass with the new test included; `pnpm build` is unaffected (no `src/ui` file changed, so `test/bundle-freshness.test.ts` needs no rebuild).

`docsText` (every docs page concatenated, per `test/docs.ts`) states both of these facts somewhere: the CSP forbids inline/eval scripts, and the CSP allows inline styles for the per-value `--size`/`--tone` overrides. Not covered by `test/docs-drift.test.ts` (that suite is scoped to the collector/source registry, unrelated to headers) — this is a new fact, so a new criterion, checked against concatenated `docsText`, never against one file's wording or heading.
